eligibilityProof: Original full native root/CF/tuple/ring/point-bits checks through exact positive volume copied byte-equivalent apart from independent failure literals. Root local/alive, 6..64 distinct complete faces, <=512 finite coordinate-unique nodes, axis-planar simple orthogonal rings, exact two reversed native-edge incidence, connected face complex, connected degree-two vertex links, exact nonzero face area and positive volume.

Each face plane equals one of the six bbox outer support coordinates. All faces are grouped by literal axis/side. A face on an interior support plane is rejected, so the existing concave-L family cannot silently enter.

Existing binary64 coordinate ranks form an exact integer grid. Each ring is mapped monotonically to even index coordinates. Each elementary bbox tile is represented by an odd/odd open centre; axis-aligned polygon boundaries cannot pass through it. Integer ray parity is exact and requires precisely one containing native ring for every tile on every one of the six sides.

Each outward ring additionally has the correct signed integer cyclic-projection area: negative on bbox lo, positive on bbox hi. Coordinate order mapping preserves orthogonal simple-ring orientation; coverage is one everywhere, so there is no positive-area overlap or gap on any bbox side.

Every emitted supporting coordinate is already an interior coordinate of an original raw point. Proposal stores old native point IDs, original bit map and incident native face IDs. Each tile stores its exact original native face; original owner/neighbour/patch/zone/rings remain separate and are never merged or reassigned.
